item.title: Greenfield school opens new computer lab
item.description: Students at Greenfield Public School will learn coding in a new computer lab. The lab has 30 laptops.

item.title: Greenfield Public School launches new computer lab
item.description: A new computer lab opened on Saturday. Officials said coding classes start next week.

item.title: City bus timings change from Monday
item.description: The city transport office changed bus timings. Morning buses will start 15 minutes earlier.

item.title: Local market holds book fair
item.description: A three-day book fair opened at the local market. Many stalls offer discounts on school books.

item.title: Coding club wins state school quiz
item.description: The Greenfield coding club won first place in the state quiz. The team practised for two months.

item.title: Heavy rain expected this weekend
item.description: The weather office expects heavy rain. People should carry umbrellas.

item.title: Winter school hours announced
item.description: Schools will open at 9 am during the winter months.
